issues.evidence: ཉོན་མོངས here (བྱེས་བགྲོད་ཉོན་མོངས) means the hardship/trouble of travelling abroad, not the mental affliction (kleśa): Sanskrit has pravāsakleśa and bo-kunpal 8-73 glosses it with "དཀའ་ཚེགས་ཀྱིས་ངལ་ཞིང་ཉོན་མོངས་པ" (wearied by hardship). 煩惱 reads as the doctrinal term for the mental afflictions.

མནོག་ཆུང་ means little gratification/enjoyment (Sanskrit alpāsvāda, "slight taste"); bo-gyaltsab 8-80 glosses it "བདེ་བའི་མནོག་ཆུང" (slight happiness), not slight profit or gain. 獲益 suggests benefit/profit.
མནོག་ཆུང་ is the slight enjoyment/gratification (Sanskrit āsvādalava), glossed in bo-gyaltsab 8-80 as "ཚེ་འདིའི་བདེ་བ་ཤིན་ཏུ་མནོག་ཆུང" (the very slight happiness of this life); 獲益 means gain/profit.
Locked rendering of སྡུག་བསྔལ is 苦; the segment has "སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཆེ་ལ" but the translation uses 苦難 instead.
